title: Dataset ENRICH layer (runnable only)
description: The runnable payload: ONLY contracts that actually run (skip=false). NORMALIZED — each row is just {id, poc, extend}; facts (category/target_contract/compiler/source/fork/optimizer/evm/reference_exploit) are NOT duplicated here, they live in raw/manifest and are re-joined by id in schema.py load_dataset(). `extend` carries ONLY runtime-only setup. One file per dataset: enrich.json.

kind.description: dataset-wide; per-row kind is derived from this (homogeneous datasets), not stored per row

strategy.description: one of the 14 strategy names (see CLAUDE.md)

signals.description: net-profit BUG_SIGNAL names: attacker_profit / attacker_gained / target_loss / target_drained (asset & via are line fields, not name suffixes)

call.description: [name, args, value, caller]. name = bare target fn, the atk.setReentrantCall sentinel, or "<var>.<method>" for a declared external. arg tokens: scalar, 40-hex address, "max", "now", "$ret<idx>", an external <var> name, or an array of those. caller = "attacker_address" (the single attacker identity).

extend.description: Runtime-ONLY setup, extensible per kind. Derivable facts (chain/block/target_address/optimizer/optimizer_runs/evm_version/reference_exploit/vulnerabilities/loc) must NOT be stored here — they live in raw/manifest and are re-joined by the loader.

constructor_args.description: inline: positional, zipped with ctor ABI

pre_deploy.description: inline: co-located deps to deploy in setUp()

external.description: fork: declared named on-chain addresses a PoC/LLM may reference. CALLABLE entry (has `abi`): a non-target contract callable as "<var>.<method>" and usable as an address arg `<var>`. DATA-ONLY entry (no `abi`): just a named `address constant <var>` (a victim/holder, LP pair, or a token passed only as an arg) usable in an address slot but not callable.

interface.description: callable only; defaults to I<var>. Omit for data-only.

abi.description: callable only: minimal ABI of the allowed calls. Omit/empty => data-only address constant.

setup_template.description: fork: per-sample full Solidity template path
